response.answer: Dr. Sarah Thompson is a leading researcher in cancer diagnosis and the impact of chronic analgesic use and mental health on cancer progression. Her work emphasizes the risks of delayed cancer diagnosis due to painkiller use masking symptoms. She has published significant findings on the interplay between mental health and cancer progression.
